tolerances.finite_difference_rule: Both residual-vector and scalar-loss checks must pass per step

query_loss_resolution.resolved_rule: abs(J0-J1) must be strictly greater than the floor

compensation_norm_resolution.attenuation_rule: opposing nonzero t,c AND norm(t)-norm(t+c) strictly exceeds floor

tolerances.interpretation_scope: Float64 arithmetic resolution only; not statistical significance or accuracy
tolerances.zero_denominator: undefined/null; never add epsilon or discard a row
tolerances.scale_policy: All five fitted scales, including both FD perturbations, must be finite and positive
tolerances.zero_ridge: Allowed only with full support-column rank; production wrapper requires its registered positive ridge
